ISO 20022 reason code BE01 indicates that the identification of the creditor (end-to-end identifier or account identification) does not match the actual account holder — the account exists but belongs to a different party. This is a creditor mismatch that cannot be resolved by retrying or editing a formatting error; the payment must be returned to the originator to verify and resubmit with correct beneficiary details, or cancelled entirely.

This is an unrepairable condition from our side since the destination account identity mismatch cannot be resolved by editing the instruction alone; the payment must be returned to the originator to provide correct and consistent beneficiary details before resubmission.
